guided.intro: Hi. A few short questions, and you can change everything at the end.
guided.trust: No account. Everything stays on this device.

sleep.question: When do you go to bed and get up?

work.question: When do you work?
work.hint: Split shift or Saturdays? Add another time.

commute.question: Does getting there and back take time?
commute.hint: For example, the bus to work.

work.question: Does getting to work and back take time?

study.question: Does getting to class and back take time?

both.question: Does getting to work or class take time?

commuteRanges.question: When do you go and come back?

work.question: When do you go to work and come back?

study.question: When do you go to class and come back?

commuteRanges.hint: We based it on your hours. Change it if it is not right.

more.question: What else do you make time for each week?

again.question: Anything else?
again.hint: Pick another, or tell me that's all.

add.title: Add to your week
add.question: What do you want to make time for?
add.hint: Pick one, or type something else.

extra.family: When do you spend time with family?
extra.friends: When do you see your friends?
extra.me: When do you have time for yourself?
extra.learning: When do you learn something new?

errors.sameTime: It starts and ends at the same time. Change one.
errors.nameDuplicate: That name is already on your list.
errors.destinationGone: What you chose in "Goes in" is gone. Pick another.

guided.resumed: Picking up where you left off.
guided.draftUnavailable: This browser can't keep a draft. Don't reload until you finish.
guided.needFix: First fix the time that is marked.

summary.title: Your typical week
summary.bubble: Here's your week. Tap anything to change it.
summary.empty: Nothing here yet. Add something or start like this.
summary.overlapping: Some times overlap. Overlapping hours count once.
summary.name: Name
summary.hasTasks: It has tasks. To remove it, go to {place}.
summary.keptForTasks: "{name}" keeps no times because it has tasks.
summary.changedElsewhere: Your week changed in another window. Here is the current version.
summary.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Your answers are still here.
summary.tooLarge: Your week has too many times to save. Remove some.
summary.addBubble: This is added to your week. Tap anything to change it.
